subject.title: acp: assistant text corrupted when Gateway revises in-progress output (non-append revision mis-sliced)

question: Should ACP replacement snapshots be represented by emitting the full revised text as another chunk, or should OpenClaw require a different ACP-compatible reset/replay strategy before closing this issue?
rationale: Gateway already exposes replacement deltas, but ACP session updates are chunk-oriented and OpenClaw's debug client appends chunks, so maintainers need to choose the intended client-visible replacement behavior before treating the fix shape as final.

options.title: Accept full revised chunks
options.body: Proceed with the linked PR shape if supported ACP clients are expected to treat a replacement delta's full text as authoritative for the in-progress message.

options.title: Require reset/replay semantics
options.body: Keep the issue open and ask for an ACP-compatible reset or replay design if append-only clients cannot render full revised chunks correctly.

recommendation.title: Accept full revised chunks
recommendation.body: Proceed with the linked PR shape if supported ACP clients are expected to treat a replacement delta's full text as authoritative for the in-progress message.

likelyOwner.reason: They recently owned the adjacent ACP final snapshot repair in this exact translator path.
